conversation.user: I need the wall ready for finishing quickly. How does block installation compare with cast-in-situ curing?
conversation.assistant:
Pre-cast hempcrete blocks arrive fully cured, so you can install them and apply finishing plaster almost immediately once mortared. In contrast, cast-in-situ wet pouring requires stripping formwork the next day and waiting 3 to 6 weeks of active drying time before you can apply your final finish. 

Are you working with a strict project deadline, or do you prefer the seamless look of a monolithic pour?
